text: Hi everyone, we are just starting the process and we have a lawyer but I still feel confused about the letters of support.. we only have 1 letter of support from an Israeli and 4 letters are from my and my partners family and friends (who are not Israeli, I made Aliyah 2 years ago). My friends in Israel also happen to not be Israeli… the lawyer is saying that there should be more letters from Israelis and that it will be “problematic” and that “ she will submit but I have to know it’s not enough “. I also asked our landlord to write a letter since he is Israeli and my partner and I live together but not sure if he will write it on time or if he will even agree to write it. My question is where am I supposed to get these letters from if it so happens to be that both my partner and I are really introverted + people we do talk to who know us as a couple are not Israeli… our lawyer made me feel so hopeless about this and I don’t understand is this really a dealbreaker when it comes to Misrad Hapnim making a decision? I would appreciate any reply since I’m very new to this process and still don’t know how it works
